description: Lek wears a long dark blue wool kaftan with brown fur at the collar and cuffs and tan geometric embroidery along the front, sleeve ends and hem. A cream high-neck shirt with blue geometric embroidered edging shows beneath it. A broad brown decorated belt with a large round metal buckle holds a patterned woven hanging sash with tassels. Loose brown trousers tuck into tall brown leather boots. His head and hands are uncovered; no armor or weapons are visible.
